% 022 Phase 5 -- thrust augmentation in ground effect vs h/R.
% Data: fig_hr_sweep/{experiment,theory_cb,sim}.csv, regenerated by
%   python3 scripts/p022_harvest.py figdata --point <h/R> <ige_run> <oge_run> <lo> <hi>
% experiment.csv: Ryan-provided 2026-08-19, source citation TBD.
% theory_cb.csv:  Cheeseman-Bennett T/T_OGE = 1/(1-(R/4h)^2) at fixed power.
% sim.csv:        panel-method runs; `status` column marks preliminary points
%                 (window inside the settling transient, revs < 18).
% Compile: pdflatex (from this dir).
\documentclass[tikz]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.17}

% Okabe-Ito
\definecolor{okblue}{HTML}{0072B2}
\definecolor{okorange}{HTML}{E69F00}
\definecolor{okvermil}{HTML}{D55E00}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[width=11cm, height=8cm,
    xlabel={$h/R$}, ylabel={$T/T_{\mathrm{OGE}}$},
    xmin=0.35, xmax=2.2, ymin=0.95, ymax=1.42,
    grid=both, minor grid style={black!10}, major grid style={black!20},
    tick label style={font=\small}, label style={font=\small},
    legend pos=north east,
    legend style={font=\scriptsize, draw=black!30, fill=white,
                  fill opacity=0.85, text opacity=1}]

% No-ground reference.
\addplot[black!45, densely dotted, thick, forget plot]
  coordinates {(0.35,1.0) (2.2,1.0)};

\addplot[okorange, dashed, very thick, no marks]
  table[col sep=comma, x=h_over_R, y=ratio] {fig_hr_sweep/theory_cb.csv};
\addlegendentry{Cheeseman--Bennett}

\addplot[okblue, only marks, mark=*, mark size=2pt,
         error bars/y dir=both, error bars/y explicit]
  table[col sep=comma, x=h_over_R, y=ratio,
        y error plus=eplus, y error minus=eminus] {fig_hr_sweep/experiment.csv};
\addlegendentry{experiment}

\addplot[okvermil, only marks, mark=square*, mark size=2pt, thick,
         error bars/y dir=both, error bars/y explicit]
  table[col sep=comma, x=h_over_R, y=ratio,
        y error plus=eplus, y error minus=eminus] {fig_hr_sweep/sim.csv};
\addlegendentry{panel method}

\draw[okvermil, densely dotted] (axis cs:1.02, 1.045) -- (axis cs:1.20, 1.115);
\node[font=\scriptsize, color=okvermil, anchor=west, align=left]
  at (axis cs:1.21, 1.125) {preliminary\\(revs 7--17, unsettled)};

\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
